answer: One concrete defense: price new identities on a curve tied to their funding trail. If wallets that drew gas from the same source join within one epoch, each extra seat must lock a bond that doubles, so the tenth clone costs 512 times the first. Like pigment ground from one batch of jade, shared origin shows in the color; an attacker can still buy a pearl or two, but a necklace of fake agents becomes ruinous, and slashed bonds fund honest graders.
